query: Download Qwen models before enabling offline serving
test_command: from pathlib import Path; source=Path('deploy/modal_app.py').read_text(); download=source.index('.run_function(download_qwen_models'); offline=source.index('"HF_HUB_OFFLINE"'); assert download < offline, 'offline mode must be enabled only after model download'

query: Install the backend model, operations, and development extras in CI
test_command: from pathlib import Path; source=Path('.github/workflows/backend-ci.yml').read_text(); assert "pip install -e 'backend[ml,ops,dev]'" in source

query: Upgrade all GitHub Actions workflows to the Node 24 action releases
test_command: from pathlib import Path; files=list(Path('.github/workflows').glob('*.yml')); text='\n'.join(path.read_text() for path in files); assert 'actions/checkout@v4' not in text; assert 'actions/setup-python@v5' not in text; assert 'actions/setup-node@v4' not in text; assert 'actions/upload-artifact@v4' not in text; assert 'actions/download-artifact@v4' not in text; assert 'actions/checkout@v7' in text; assert 'actions/download-artifact@v8' in text

query: Activate scheduled GitHub and PyPI polling into Neon and add pgvector maintenance
test_command: from pathlib import Path; source=Path('deploy/modal_app.py').read_text(); required=['collector_image','collect_live_repositories','adoptrank-database','adoptrank-github','modal.Cron(','index_production_vectors','populate_pgvector']; missing=[item for item in required if item not in source]; assert not missing, f'missing production polling/vector behavior: {missing}'

query: Add a serverless Modal L4 GPU deployment for the FastAPI Qwen ranking service
test_command: from pathlib import Path; path=Path('deploy/modal_app.py'); assert path.exists(); source=path.read_text(); required=['modal.App(','gpu="L4"','@modal.asgi_app()','adoptrank_backend.service']; missing=[item for item in required if item not in source]; assert not missing, f'missing Modal serving behavior: {missing}'
